verdict.rationale: Tilled offers robust APIs for payments, merchants, disputes, webhooks, batches, and onboarding (docs-3,5,7,8,18,19,22,23,35), but several dashboard-only actions are documented without an API equivalent — viewing payout speed (tilled-docs-10/31), creating pricing templates (tilled-docs-21), and general merchant/dispute management explicitly tied to the Dashboard (tilled-docs-11,30) — suggesting UI-only surface area for some workflows. missing for 10: API endpoints for payout speed retrieval, pricing template creation/management via API, and confirmation that all merchant/dispute dashboard actions have full API parity.
